def row(x, n):
    return (x-1)//n

def col(x, n):
    return (x-1)%n

n, t = [int(num) for num in input().split()]
lst = [int(num) for num in input().split()]

rows = [0 for i in range(n)]
cols = [0 for i in range(n)]
d1 = 0
d2 = 0
bingo = -1

    r = row(lst[i], n)
    c = col(lst[i], n)
    rows[r] += 1 
    cols[c] += 1 
    if r == c:
        d1 += 1 
    if r + c == n - 1:
        d2 += 1 
    if rows[r] == n or cols[c] == n or d1 == n or d2 == n:
        bingo = i + 1
        break
